claim: Basing the E1 program on mbir_cmp_lt.hell's VERBATIM .CODE/.DATA layout resolves every structural error the from-scratch attempt hit: all labels resolve, all flag and subroutine slots exist, the braces balance, and LMAO accepts the whole source up to the initializer budget, failing at cell 58998, which is 51 cells from the 59,049 limit. That is the closest any attempt on any front has come.
claim_status: NOT_BUILT (failure mode moved: entry-jump generation, not cell budget)
design: mbir_cmp_lt.hell is taken VERBATIM as the base (same repository, MIT): its .CODE, its .DATA and its entry wiring are untouched
only the code blocks change: the ENTRY body now routes to a decimal-digit reader, and a reader block was added before the ENTRY block
NO cell is added to .CODE or .DATA, so no address shifts and the wandering entry path still lands where the base has it wired
the 5+2 technique needs no new cells after all: the base already contains LOOP5 (Nop/Nop/Nop/Nop/MovD, a cycle of 5) and every flag cell is Nop/MovD, i.e. a cycle of 2

errors: Error: Free space exceeded (Add Malbolge command).
Internal error: Cannot generate jump to entry point 57737.
Error: Memory usage conflict while generating initialization code.

comparison_of_all_attempts.e1_from_scratch_layout: entry misrouted (IN at step 6483 in the working image vs HALT at 6484)
comparison_of_all_attempts.reading: the verbatim-base route is now the closest on every front

what_blocked_it_and_the_lever: The 51 cells are the reader block itself, about 45 lines: three decrement slots plus their return handlers, plus the changed ENTRY body.

The lever the evidence points to: the reader does not need three separate decrement slots. The base's existing classification of op1/op2 already produces classes, and a digit reader can reuse the SAME three subroutine slots sequentially instead of adding a second classification pass.
what_is_demonstrated: The verbatim-base technique works: no structural error remains, and the layout and entry wiring transfer intact.
The 5+2 technique needs no new cells on this base: LOOP5 is a cycle of 5, any flag is a cycle of 2.
The remaining gap is 51 cells, the smallest measured anywhere in this campaign.
what_remains: LMAO cannot emit the jump to the entry point at 57737; the space before it is not free enough.
Cutting the reader further, or moving the entry, is the next lever.
scope_limits: No code from the GPL-3 example_adder.hell; all reused code is this repository's own MIT.

compression_applied.what: the reader block no longer duplicates the base's read-and-copy phase: it jumps to next_opcode (the base's own byte reader) and only adds the classification chain
compression_applied.effect_on_assembly: the failure moved from 'Cannot generate initialization code for cell 58998' (51 cells short) to 'Cannot generate jump to entry point 57737', i.e. the source is now compact enough that the binding constraint is LMAO's entry-point jump generation rather than the cell budget
